Name: Alecktoo's Pink Duck Bobber
Author: kirinkode
Description:
[font=Courier New][u][b]About[/b][/u] 
another very simple visual bobber mod that changes either the skull bobber or vanilla duck bobber into a cute pink duck! 

[u][b]How Do I Unlock More Bobbers?[/b][/u]
They're unlocked by catching 2 [u]new[/u] fish each. You'll always get the first bobber as your default but to unlock the second one you'll need to catch 2 new fish and so on.

[u][b]Config Options[/b][/u]
I highly suggest using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make life a whole lot easier for you. By default this mod will replace the skull bobber. It's your choice for which vanilla bobber you choose to replace and you CAN replace both or neither if that's what your heart desires! 
﻿
[b][i][u]Using GMCM: [/u][/i][/b]
check whichever box you want to trade out for the pink duck

[i][b][u]Changing Through config.json[/u]
[/b][/i]open Config.json (Mods/[CP]Alecktoo's Pink Duck Bobber/Config.json)[/font][font=Courier New][i][b]
[/b][/i]
change the true/false to whatever you please

True: Pink duck mod turned ON to replace bobber
False: Pink duck mod turned OFF and will not replace bobber
